samples.summary: Goal now reads "Leaving a document that holds unpushed edits requires a deliberate confirmation — closing or reloading the tab, and navigating away inside the app", stated without qualification, while browser back/forward remains unguarded (acknowledged only far below in Risks). The Goals section is where readers calibrate what the feature promises; an unqualified goal that the implementation knowingly does not fully meet is the kind of claim this doc elsewhere is careful not to make. Suggest a parenthetical pointer to the POP limitation.
